notes: Per-year school vaccination rate workbooks (K, 7th, 12th) by school. maine.gov 403s non-browser clients. The page's hrefs are not all live (2020-2021 and 2022-2023 point at data-reports/ paths that 404); every workbook is served from sites/maine.gov.dhhs.mecdc/files/immunization-reports/<basename>, which is where the ingest fetches them. The 2024-25 href carries a literal space. 2021-2022 is no longer linked; its copy stays in raw/.
